summary: This is a clipped ClimeCo web page promoting carbon offsetting for businesses and individuals. It explains that ClimeCo helps measure and offset carbon footprints and plastic waste, lists featured carbon and plastic credit projects, describes partner programs, and offers a purchase calculator. A testimonial from Third Eye Blind's Stephan Jenkins and a short list of recent news headlines from March 2024 are also included.
one_line: ClimeCo's shop page for purchasing carbon and plastic credits to offset individual and business emissions, with featured projects and partner programs.
key_facts: ClimeCo offers businesses of all sizes help to measure and offset their carbon footprint, plastic waste, shipping/travel emissions, and more.
The page states that the average American's carbon footprint from home, work, travel and everything else is 50,000 pounds a year.
The carbon offset purchase calculator has a minimum entry of $12.50 and a default amount of $100.00.
Offset frequency options on the calculator are One-Time, Monthly, Quarterly and Yearly.
ClimeCo states that the projects it supports are third-party validated and verified to meet the highest standards.
A featured project is 'Conserving Coastal Forestland and First Nations' under carbon credits.
A featured plastic credits project is 'Collecting Ocean Bound Plastic Waste in Southeast Asia to Protect Biodiversity'.
A featured carbon credits project is 'Educating The Next Energy Generation Workforce'.
The EcoCommitted Partner Program is aimed at small to midsize businesses.
The ClimeCo Certified Program is aimed at large companies.
Stephan Jenkins, lead singer and guitarist of Third Eye Blind, said ClimeCo determines your carbon footprint and then you purchase carbon credits which counteracts the carbon you put into the air.
A March 13, 2024 news item reports that ClimeCo and Music Sustainability Alliance released a report on the state of sustainability efforts and attitudes in the live music industry.
A March 12, 2024 news item covers the implications of the SEC's New Climate Disclosure Rule.
A March 20, 2024 news item covers engaging with suppliers to drive ESG and financial performance.
The contact email listed in the footer is purchasehelp@climeco.com.
